info.title: Pingdom Universal API
info.description: Monitor uptime, manage alerts, and run synthetic checks

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

paused.description: Pause the check immediately after creation.

resolution.description: How often the check should run, in minutes.

userIds.description: Comma-separated list of user identifiers to alert.

sendNotificationWhenDown.description: Send a notification when the check has been down this many times.

notifyAgainEvery.description: Send another notification every n results. Use 0 to disable repeat notifications.

notifyWhenBackUp.description: Notify again when the check is back up.

tags[].description: Tags to assign to the check.

probeFilters[].description: Probe selection filters such as region filters.

ipv6.description: Use IPv6 instead of IPv4 when applicable.

responseTimeThreshold.description: Response-time threshold in milliseconds that triggers a down alert.

integrationIds[].description: Integration identifiers to associate with the check.

customMessage.description: Custom message appended to email and webhook alerts.
